thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: service=redwood-embeddings alert=embeddings-queue-high-error-rate region=eu-west-1 priority=P1 summary=spike in 5xxs and consumers OOM'ing

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: maya.pagerduty acknowledged the page (reason: heading in).

Maya Patel: acked, oncall taking. pulling logs + checking rollout history. any customer-visible impact?

Chris Nguyen: seeing 502/503s from /v1/embeddings backpressure. spike started ~09:02 UTC. autoscaler didn't kick the last minute.

Dan R.: we have consumer pods restarting with OOMKilled; looks like kv-cache growth + legacy batching bump.

Maya Patel: ok - immediate plan: 1) scale embeddings-consumer to 10 2) roll traffic to fallback-enc-small for non-critical customers 3) restart problematic pods one-by-one to clear mem pressure.

Sean (SRE): +1. I can run the scale now. doing a quick check on node free memory first.

Chris Nguyen: also creating a temporary mem-limit override for the consumer to avoid OOM until we patch the batching bug.

Maya Patel: go ahead. Linda — can you surface if any customers opened support tickets? we might need AP/CS to notify.

Linda (CSM): on it. I see two enterprise customers reporting elevated error rates in EU, contacted via in-app. prepping a short note: "We’re investigating elevated errors for embeddings in EU and mitigating; ETA ~20-30m".

Sean (SRE): running:
```
kubectl scale deployment embeddings-consumer -n inference --replicas=10
kubectl rollout status deployment/embeddings-consumer -n inference
```

Sean (SRE): nodes look healthy, scaled to 10, new pods scheduled. still seeing some 5xx from older pods in the last 30s.

Dan R.: restarting oldest pod to free KV cache: `kubectl delete pod embeddings-consumer-5b7d9` (will respawn).

Maya Patel: after restart, monitor request latencies and error rates. I'll add a temporary SLO alert silence for noisy signals.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: page status updated: acknowledged by Maya Patel.

Chris Nguyen: quick mitigation check: enabling fallback routing for non-critical keys. patching router with `route-profile: fallback-enc-small` for tier=free & tier=dev.

Maya Patel: noted. let's make sure ent customers keep using primary - Linda will coordinate.

Linda (CSM): sending note to affected accounts now. cc-ing support.

Sean (SRE): error rate dipping, 5xx rate down from 8% -> 1.2% in last 2 mins. KV cache rebuild slower on a few pods.

Dan R.: started rolling restart across deployment with maxUnavailable=1. patching deployment to bump resource limits and add a guard on batch_size.

Maya Patel: who's owning the root cause follow-up? want a quick postmortem and an action to fix autoscaler thresholds and batch safety checks.

Chris Nguyen: I'll take RCFA + follow-up. plan: reproduce local with KC cache, add limits on batch growth, improve autoscaler trigger (increase threshold sensitivity around queue depth).

Maya Patel: cool. timeline?

Chris Nguyen: aiming for a postmortem draft within 48h, hotfix the batching guard within 6h, autoscaler tweak in next 24h.

Maya Patel: nice. status ping in 10m. for now priority=mitigated? still P1 until errors settle under SLO for 10m.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty note: escalation policy paused (manual) by Maya Patel.

Sean (SRE): monitoring dashboards show median latency stable; 95th still elevated slightly. working on clearing cold caches.

Maya Patel: update for exec/ops: impacted region=eu-west-1, approx affected requests ~0.6% of global traffic, estimated customer-impact window started 09:02 UTC to mitigation in progress. Linda to lead customer comms.

Linda (CSM): sent short note + SLA follow-up to impacted customers; offer escalation contact if they need immediate help.

Chris Nguyen: pushing hotfix branch with batch cap + kv-cache guard. will coordinate deploy once Dan verifies rollout behavior.

Dan R.: verifying hotfix on staging, no regressions so far.

Maya Patel: thanks all. keep thread for status updates. I'll mark page as resolved once we sustain <0.5% errors for 15m.

(10 minutes later)

Sean (SRE): 5xx down to 0.3% for 12m. 95th latency back to normal.

Maya Patel: marking as resolved in PagerDuty now. good job.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: incident resolved by Maya Patel.

Chris Nguyen: adding task to backlog: improve autoscaler sensitivity + add KV-cache growth alarm.

Maya Patel: assign owners: Chris for code fix + postmortem, Dan for rollout verification, Sean for metric alerting. Linda for customer follow-up. I'll draft a short timeline for the postmortem channel.

Linda (CSM): thanks — I'll follow up with customers and attach the incident summary.

(End of thread)
